title: About
text:
My name is Veerawat (Raymond) Udomvorakulchai. I am currently a Chemical Engineering PhD student at University College London (UCL). My research interest is in process systems engineering (PSE), focusing on developing tools to optimize real-world complex processes.
Some publications on multi-agent systems for hybrid optimization under the supervision of Prof. Eric S. Fraga can be found below:
